title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-27
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A/Dolby B) -> Korg MR1000 (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24
source: (FOB) (2)Beyer M160 + (1)Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-C90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard‑type source with a standout Playing > Terrapin > Playing sandwich and superb midrange clarity.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this recording as the best‑sounding source they’ve found, highlighting its open mids, reduced audience bleed and great headphone/DAC compatibility. Musically the band is praised for listening to each other, with the Playing > Terrapin > Playing sequence cited as a highlight that foreshadows the legendary Frost ’82 shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on both audio fidelity and performance, but only a single review limits certainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Open, crisp mids with a pleasant midrange bump; less audience noise than comparable sources; sounds great on headphones and DAC.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band > Terrapin Station > Playing in the Band
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight sandwich around Terrapin shows strong group interplay and a smooth, engaging flow.
